title: Pierre the Pigeon-Hawk
overview: In New York City, Pierre, born as a product of forbidden love between a hawk and a pigeon, is rejected by both communities. Tired of not fitting in, Pierre sets out on a mission to discover where he truly belongs.

title: Sivka-Burka
overview: Ivan is the youngest son in the family, and everyone considers him a fool. When his old father died, Ivan, the only one of his three sons, fulfilled his request and visited his father's grave for three days. For this, the secret of the magic horse Sivka-Burka was revealed to him, which can make Ivan a wonderful young man. Meanwhile, the king decided to marry his princess daughter to the one who would kiss her, jumping to a high tower.

title: Manyunya: Childhood of the Ba. In Cinema
Alpine Ballad
overview: 1943. Soviet soldier Ivan escapes from a death camp in the Italian Alps. However, his plans are thwarted by two unexpected companions: the famous German film star Dieter Schulze and the Italian anti-fascist Giulia.
